title.en: Zibu Takes Care of His Ball

lesson.en: We must take care of our things so they stay safe and clean.
lesson.es: Debemos cuidar nuestras cosas para que se mantengan seguras y limpias.

en.title: Zibu Takes Care of His Ball 🐶 Learn Animal Sounds! | Zibu and Friends
en.description:
Zibu receives a bright red ball to play with his friends! 🐶
Toby the puppy joins in and makes cute sounds like WOOF! 🐶
When Zibu leaves his ball behind, it rolls away down the hill.
Join Zibu, Lila, and Toby as they learn to take care of their toys!
Kids will learn animal sounds and how to care for their things. ❤️
#ZibuAndFriends #ToddlerLearning #KidsCartoons #AnimalSounds #LearnToCare

es.title: Zibu cuida su pelota 🐶 ¡Aprende sonidos de animales! | Zibu y sus amigos
es.description:
¡Zibu recibe una linda pelota roja para jugar! 🐶
Toby el perrito llega a jugar y hace divertidos sonidos como ¡GUAU! 🐶
Cuando Zibu olvida su pelota, ¡esta rueda por la colina!
Acompaña a Zibu, Lila y Toby a aprender a cuidar sus juguetes.
¡Los niños aprenderán sonidos de animales y a cuidar sus cosas! ❤️
#ZibuYSusAmigos #CaricaturasParaNiños #SonidosDeAnimales #VideosEducativos #NiñosPequeños

lines.en: Oh no! The red ball is rolling away!
Friend, can you help us find it?
Let's go look for it together!
Zibu Takes Care of His Ball!
Inside their bedroom, Zibu and Lila found a big surprise box!
lines.es: ¡En su habitación, Zibu y Lila encontraron una gran caja de sorpresa!

lines.en: Look, Lila! A gift box! What could be inside?
lines.es: ¡Mira, Lila! ¡Una caja de regalo! ¿Qué habrá adentro?

lines.en: Open it, Zibu! Open it!
Zibu carefully opened the box...
lines.es: Zibu abrió la caja con mucho cuidado...

lines.en: Wow! A bright red ball! I love it!
It's so shiny and red! What a great toy!
lines.es: ¡Es tan brillante y roja! ¡Qué gran juguete!

lines.en: Suddenly, a sweet little puppy walked into the room.
lines.es: De repente, un perrito muy lindo entró en la habitación.

lines.en: Woof! Woof!
Oh! Look, Zibu! It's Toby!
Hello, Toby! Look at my new red ball!
Arf! Arf!
Toby wagged his tail happily. He liked the ball too!
lines.es: Toby movió la cola feliz. ¡A él también le gustó la pelota!

lines.en: Let's go outside and play with it!
Yay! To the garden!
Out in the sunny garden, Zibu, Lila, and Toby played together.
lines.es: Afuera en el jardín soleado, Zibu, Lila y Toby jugaban juntos.

lines.en: Catch the ball, Lila! Here it goes!
I got it! Wheee!
Lila gently rolled the red ball across the grass.
lines.es: Lila rodó suavemente la pelota roja por el pasto.

lines.en: Woof! Woof!
Ha ha! Listen to Toby! He said WOOF!
Toby loves the red ball!
lines.es: ¡A Toby le encanta la pelota roja!

lines.en: Yip! Yip!
Toby made happy puppy sounds as he chased the ball.
lines.es: Toby hacía sonidos felices de perrito mientras perseguía la pelota.

lines.en: Good boy, Toby! You're a fast puppy!
lines.es: ¡Buen chico, Toby! ¡Eres un perrito muy rápido!

lines.en: Rolling the ball back and forth is so fun!
lines.es: ¡Rodar la pelota de un lado a otro es muy divertido!

lines.en: Yes! I will take very good care of my ball!
lines.es: ¡Sí! ¡Voy a cuidar muy bien mi pelota!

lines.en: Everyone was having a wonderful time playing together.
lines.es: Todos la estaban pasando de maravilla jugando juntos.

lines.en: Zibu, Lila, and Toby walked up the high green hill.
lines.es: Zibu, Lila y Toby subieron a la colina verde y alta.

lines.en: Up, up, up! What a nice hill!
It is very high, Zibu! Hold onto your ball!
Woof! Woof!
Don't worry, Lila! My ball is safe with me!
lines.es: ¡No te preocupes, Lila! ¡Mi pelota está segura conmigo!

lines.en: Just then, a beautiful butterfly flew into the air.
lines.es: En ese momento, una hermosa mariposa voló por el aire.

lines.en: Look, Zibu! A pretty butterfly!
Wow! Look at its shiny wings!
Zibu set his ball down on the grass to watch it.
lines.es: Zibu puso su pelota en el pasto para verla.

lines.en: Flutter, flutter! Goodbye, butterfly!
Yip! Yip!
Zibu... you are not holding your ball!
Oh no! Zibu forgot to hold his toy on the sloping hill!
lines.es: ¡Oh, no! ¡Zibu olvidó sujetar su juguete en la colina!

lines.en: A gentle breeze began to blow across the hill.
lines.es: Una brisa suave comenzó a soplar por la colina.

lines.en: Uh oh! The wind is blowing!
And the red ball started to roll down the slope!
lines.es: ¡Y la pelota roja comenzó a rodar colina abajo!

lines.en: Oh no! My ball is rolling away!
Woof! Woof!
Quick! Let's catch it!
The ball rolled faster and faster down the grassy hill!
lines.es: ¡La pelota rodó cada vez más rápido por la colina de pasto!

lines.en: Wait for me! Stop, ball, stop!
Swish! The ball rolled straight into a big pile of leaves!
lines.es: ¡Zás! ¡La pelota rodó directo a una gran pila de hojas!

lines.en: Oh dear! Where did it go?
Arf... arf?
Oh... I forgot to take care of my ball.
Zibu felt sad. He realized he should have held onto his toy.
lines.es: Zibu se sintió triste. Se dio cuenta de que debió sujetar su juguete.

lines.en: Zibu, Lila, and Toby went down the hill to look for the ball.
lines.es: Zibu, Lila y Toby bajaron la colina para buscar la pelota.

lines.en: Where is my red ball? I can't see it!
lines.es: ¿Dónde está mi pelota roja? ¡No la veo!

lines.en: Don't worry, Zibu! We can search together.
lines.es: ¡No te preocupes, Zibu! Podemos buscar juntos.

lines.en: Lila picked up a big leaf to move the dry grass.
lines.es: Lila tomó una hoja grande para mover la hierba seca.

lines.en: Look! I can sweep the leaves with this!
Let me help too! Move... move... move!
They pushed away the grass, but the red ball was not there.
lines.es: Empujaron la hierba, pero la pelota roja no estaba allí.

lines.en: Oh no... where could it be?
Sniff... sniff... arf?
Toby used his little nose to sniff all around.
lines.es: Toby usó su pequeña nariz para olfatear por todos lados.

lines.en: Look at Toby! He is sniffing the ground!
Woof! Woof!
Toby ran right over to a big pile of leaves!
lines.es: ¡Toby corrió directo hacia un gran montón de hojas!

lines.en: Toby pushed a big green leaf with his nose.
lines.es: Toby empujó una gran hoja verde con su nariz.

lines.en: WOOF! WOOF!
Look, Zibu! Toby found something!
Is it my ball?
There it was! The red ball was hiding under the leaf!
lines.es: ¡Ahí estaba! ¡La pelota roja estaba escondida bajo la hoja!

lines.en: My ball! Yay! You found it, Toby!
Arf! Arf!
Oh... but look. It has some dirt on it.
lines.es: Oh... pero miren. Tiene un poco de tierra.

lines.en: The ball was dirty from rolling in the leaves.
lines.es: La pelota estaba sucia por rodar en las hojas.

lines.en: That's okay! We can clean it!
Zibu gently wiped the dirt off his ball.
lines.es: Zibu limpió suavemente la tierra de su pelota.

lines.en: Now it's clean and bright again!
lines.es: ¡Ahora está limpia y brillante otra vez!

lines.en: Taking care of our toys keeps them clean!
Zibu hugged his clean red ball. He was so happy!
lines.es: Zibu abrazó su pelota roja limpia. ¡Estaba muy feliz!

lines.en: Back in their cozy room, Zibu brought his clean red ball.
lines.es: De regreso en su acogedora habitación, Zibu trajo su pelota roja limpia.

lines.en: Look! Here is the box for my ball!
lines.es: ¡Miren! ¡Aquí está la caja para mi pelota!

lines.en: Woof! Woof!
That is the perfect place for your ball, Zibu!
lines.es: ¡Ese es el lugar perfecto para tu pelota, Zibu!

lines.en: Zibu gently put the ball inside the safe box.
lines.es: Zibu puso suavemente la pelota dentro de la caja segura.

lines.en: Now you are safe and clean, ball!
It won't get lost or dirty in there!
lines.es: ¡No se perderá ni se ensuciará ahí!

lines.en: Yip! Yip!
Thank you for helping us today, Toby!
Woof!
Taking care of our toys is so good!
Yes! Now it is ready for next time!
lines.es: ¡Sí! ¡Ahora está lista para la próxima vez!

lines.en: Taking care of our things keeps them safe and clean.
lines.es: Cuidar nuestras cosas las mantiene seguras y limpias.

lines.en: Good job, Zibu! Goodbye, friends!
Take care of your toys every day!
Keep them safe so we can play!
Put them back into their box!
Clean and safe for everyone!
I keep my red ball safe and bright!
We wipe the dirt and make it right!
Put it away when play is done!
Taking care of things is fun!
Take care of your toys every day!
Keep them safe so we can play!
Put them back into their box!
Clean and safe for everyone!
One more time! Sing with us!
Take care of your toys every day!
Keep them safe so we can play!
Put them back into their box!
Clean and safe for everyone!
I keep my red ball safe and bright!
We wipe the dirt and make it right!
Put it away when play is done!
Taking care of things is fun!
Take care of your toys every day!
Keep them safe so we can play!
Put them back into their box!
Clean and safe for everyone!
Woof! Woof! Arf!
Did you like the story? Let's remember it together!
lines.es: ¿Les gustó la historia? ¡Vamos a recordarla juntos!

lines.en: What gift did Zibu find inside the box?
lines.es: ¿Qué regalo encontró Zibu dentro de la caja?

lines.en: A red ball!
Who was Zibu's puppy friend?
lines.es: ¿Quién era el amigo perrito de Zibu?

lines.en: Toby!
Where did the red ball roll down?
Down the grassy hill!
Who found the ball under a leaf?
lines.es: ¿Quién encontró la pelota debajo de una hoja?

lines.en: Toby the puppy!
Where did Zibu put his ball at the end?
lines.es: ¿Dónde puso Zibu su pelota al final?

lines.en: In its safe box!
Let me clean my imaginary ball with you!
Wipe, wipe, wipe! Now it's clean!
Now let's put it safely in the box!
lines.es: ¡Ahora a guardarla bien en la caja!

lines.en: Yay! Good job taking care of things!
We must take care of our things so they stay safe and clean.
lines.es: Debemos cuidar nuestras cosas para que se mantengan seguras y limpias.

lines.en: Dance party! Dance with us, friends!
Move your paws like puppy Toby!
lines.es: ¡Muevan las patitas como el perrito Toby!

lines.en: See you next time, friends!
Bye-bye!
